title: cursor
summary: MSUI installs the shipped cursor art as true top-left-hotspot OS cursors and applies Benilla's unit and GameObject classifiers: Attack, Speak, Pickup/LootAll, Interact, Buy, Inspect, Trainer, Taxi, Skin, Repair, Mail, Mine, GatherHerbs and PickLock with Unable twins and reference range gates. An armed item-target spell, including Enchanting, now uses the same authored Cast pair: blue Cast while the pointer is over UI and gray UnableCast over the world, replacing MSUI's former green text prompt. GameObject mouseover, +64 brighten, cursor and right-click USE are separate exact strategy gates, including GO-to-player faction reaction, hostile-trap inversion, marker/generic/capture/transport behavior and meeting-stone/fishing overrides. Lock.dbc retains Action and the ordered key/skill resolver uses known opener spells, current skill plus bonuses, key possession, GO state/level and GO_FLAG_LOCKED. Foreground drawing survives only as a custom-cursor backend fallback; live verification remains.

openItems.text: No world-hover cursor classification: hovering an attackable unit, gossip/vendor/trainer/taxi NPC, or lootable corpse never changes the cursor (no Attack/Speak/Buy/Trainer/Taxi/Loot/Skin modes, no Unable* range-grayed variants).
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: WorldCursorUiLaw and GameLoop.WorldCursor implement the unit service/attack/loot/skin classifier, shipped BLP stems and range-grayed twins; Targeting consumes the same service verdict for right-click dispatch. GameObject cursors remain separately open.

openItems.text: Point.blp now replaces the OS arrow visually in-world, but MSUI foreground-renders the cursor rather than installing a zero-lag hardware cursor as current Benilla does.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: ClientWindow now installs MPQ-decoded cursor BLPs through Silk's custom OS cursor with exact non-premultiplied RGBA conversion and hotspot (0,0). Point renews base authority each gameplay frame, specific UI/world stems replace it, and the old foreground quad is retained only when the backend refuses custom cursors. Focused clinical checks and the client build pass.

openItems.text: Data-driven GameObject cursor modes remain absent: Mail, Mine/UnableMine, GatherHerbs/UnableGatherHerbs, PickLock, and TEXT-plaque Inspect/UnableInspect.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: GameObject templates + the first Lock.dbc requirement now select Mail, Inspect, Mine, GatherHerbs, PickLock or Interact, including quest activate, busy/no-interact, chair/fishing ranges and PickLock's never-gray rule.

openItems.text: GameObject cursor refinements still omit faction reaction, the complete lock/key/skill usability resolver, and the exact distinction between mouseover eligibility and highlightability for marker/generic/transport strategies.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: Split mouseover eligibility, brighten, cursor and USE gates by the current per-type strategy table; added GO-to-player reaction with hostile TRAP inversion, marker/generic/capture/transport exceptions, fishing/meeting overrides, and the ordered Lock.dbc Action/key/skill resolver with actual Scholomance row verification.

openItems.text: Enchanting's armed item target displays a custom green 'Select item' text prompt instead of Benilla's Cast hardware cursor, whose base is blue over UI and whose item-only world verdict is UnableCast.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: WorldCursorUiLaw owns the item-target Cast/UnableCast fork. The late cursor pass installs Cast over UI and UnableCast over the world through the existing hardware-cursor pipeline while an item spell is armed; the non-reference text prompt is removed without changing action-bar geometry or scaling.

openItems.text: Focused laws, source fences and actual Lock.dbc rows pass. Needs owner-run live hover/use checks on a sign, anvil, transport, hostile trap, quest-gated chest, fishing bobber, herb/vein, keyed door and meeting stone, plus confirmation that Point/service mode swaps are hardware-composited with no duplicate foreground cursor or render-frame lag.

Owner-run desktop visual acceptance: press Create on an Enchanting recipe, confirm the authored blue Cast hardware cursor over the CraftFrame and bag/paper-doll UI, gray UnableCast over the world, no green text prompt, and correct persistence through Cancel/No followed by Escape or a successful item click.
